The State of Illinois Department of Innovation & Technology (DoIT) is hiring a Web Developer to support the Illinois State Police. The role develops and maintains web applications and distributed systems, consults with users on technical needs, and provides guidance to staff.
Non Profit
Government
Professional Services
Real Estate
Association
Office Administration
Comp. & Benefits
No H1B
Responsibilities
Under general direction, serves as a Web Developer for the Department of Innovation & Technology (DoIT), supporting the Illinois State Police (ISP), performing difficult and specialized professional web application development work in the law enforcement unit B
Performs technical and advisory tasks in the areas of design, construction, and maintenance of applications
Interviews and consults with users on distributed- and web-based data processing needs and technical studies
Maintains, analyzes, recommends, and enhances new procedures and techniques to improve the supported application systems
Serves as a resource and contact for users of web systems, other technical staff, and the ISP help desk personnel
Provides guidance and training to lower-level staff on the proper programming techniques, applications, documentation, standards, and requirements
Keeps abreast of new developments in the Information Technology field by continuing education through online training platforms,meetings, training sessions, seminars, and conferences to increase familiarity with and remain current on products, vendors, techniques, and procedures
Performs other duties as required or assigned which are reasonably within the scope of duties enumerated above
Qualification
Web Application Development
Distributed Systems
Object-Oriented Programming
.NET
C#.NET
JQuery
JavaScript
SQL Server
Azure DevOps
Feasibility Studies
Required
Requires knowledge, skill, and mental development equivalent to completion of four (4) years of college with course work in computer science or directly related fields
Requires one (1) year of professional experience in Web Services or a related Information Technology field
Requires one (1) year of professional experience designing, developing, and enhancing complex  web applications and distributed systems
Requires one (1) year of professional experience developing web applications using Object-Oriented (OO) programming languages, applying OO principles to create scalable, maintainable, and modular solutions
Requires one (1) year of professional experience building and maintaining web applications using .NET (framework and core), C#.NET, JQuery/JavaScript, and SQL Server, including developing complex routines, interfaces, and data-driven components
Requires one (1) year of professional experience conducting feasibility studies for system conversions and enhancements, including evaluating existing architectures, recommending improvements, and supporting technical planning and decision-making
Requires employment authorization to accept permanent full-time position with the State of Illinois
Preferred
One (1) year of professional experience designing, developing, and enhancing complex web applications and distributed systems
One (1) year of professional experience developing web applications using Object-Oriented (OO) programming languages, applying OO principles to create scalable, maintainable, and modular solutions
One (1) year of professional experience building and maintaining web applications using .NET (framework and core), C#.NET, JQuery/JavaScript, and SQL Server, including developing complex routines, interfaces, and data-driven components
One (1) year of professional experience conducting feasibility studies for system conversions and enhancements, including evaluating existing architectures, recommending improvements, and supporting technical planning and decision-making
One (1) year of professional web development experience using Azure DevOps (ADO) for source control, work item management, build and release pipelines, and collaborative development withing structured project environments
Ability to prepare testing plans, test scripts, and test data for new or modified applications, ensuring system reliability, compliance with standards, and successful implementation of distributed system enhancements
Ability to analyze data and system behaviors logically, exercising sound judgment to identify, diagnose, and resolve operational or procedural problems within web and distributed applications
Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with agency officials, associates, vendors, clients, and others, supporting collaborative system planning, design, and troubleshooting efforts
Developed verbal and written communications skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to users, stakeholders, and team members, and prepare precise documentation, recommendations, and specifications
Demonstrated organizational and prioritization, with the ability to manage multiple competing assignments, support emergency requests, and maintain responsiveness within a fast‑paced application development environment
Benefits
Competitive Group Insurance benefits including health, life, dental and vision plans
Flexible work schedules (when available and dependent upon position)
10 -25 days of paid vacation time annually (10 days for first year of state employment)
12 days of paid sick time annually which carryover year to year
3 paid personal business days per year
13-14 paid holidays per year dependent on election years
12 weeks of paid parental leave
Pension plan through the State Employees Retirement System
Deferred Compensation Program – voluntary supplemental retirement plan
Optional pre-tax programs -Medical Care Assistance Plan (MCAP) & Dependent Care Assistant Plan
Tuition Reimbursement Program and Federal Public Service Loan Forgiveness Program eligibility
